text: The sharing economy outran its legal frameworks: the legal regimes governing the disrupted industries were often incompatible with the trends the sharing economy generated, forcing cities and municipalities into a proactive regulatory stance.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808859

isBasedOn.name: Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades

abstract: The legal frameworks that regulate disrupted and associated industries were often incompatible with the emerging trends generated by the sharing economy.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to ridesharing and homesharing regulation at city and state level
